d:
Chandragupt aachary vishnugupt ke lie chintit hai. uska sahpathi akshay batata hai ki sabhi aachary chhatr aachary ke priy hai magar chandragupt unhen sabse zyada priy hai. tabhi to vah unki anupasthiti se sabse adhik vyakul hai.aage kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
Chandragupta is worried for Vishnugupta. His classmate Akshay says that all Acharya students are dear to Acharya but Chandragupta is most dear to him. That's why he is most distressed by their absence. Watch what happens next in this part.
Episode 14 Part -1 of a 47-part historical drama Chanakya. An epic Indian television series.
